Recipe text:
Spinach dal
Serves 4. Prep 10 mins. Cook 30 mins.

Ingredients
200 g red lentils, rinsed
1 onion, finely chopped
2 cloves garlic, crushed
1 tsp ground cumin
1 ½ tsp turmeric
400 ml vegetable stock
100 g baby spinach
Salt to taste

Method
1. Fry the onion in a little oil for 5 minutes until soft.
2. Add the garlic, cumin and turmeric and cook for 1 minute.
3. Add the lentils and stock, bring to the boil, then simmer for 20 minutes.
4. Stir in the spinach until wilted. Season with salt.

Recipe text:
Lemon herb couscous (serves 2)

1 1/4 cups couscous
½ cup boiling water
2-3 tbsp olive oil
1 lemon, zested and juiced
salt and pepper to taste
chopped parsley, to garnish

Pour the boiling water over the couscous, cover and leave for 5 minutes.
Fluff with a fork, then stir through the oil, lemon zest and juice.
Season and scatter with parsley.

Banana Bread
★★★★★ 4.9 from 1,203 reviews
Prep Time: 15 minutes | Cook Time: 1 hour | Makes 1 loaf

INGREDIENTS
3 ripe bananas, mashed
75 g butter, melted
150 g light brown sugar
1 large egg, beaten
1 tsp vanilla extract
1 tsp bicarbonate of soda
pinch of salt
190 g plain flour

INSTRUCTIONS
Heat the oven to 180C and line a loaf tin.
Mix the bananas, butter, sugar, egg and vanilla in a large bowl.
Stir in the bicarb, salt and flour until just combined.
Pour into the tin and bake for 55-60 minutes until a skewer comes out clean. Cool for 10 minutes in the tin.

COMMENTS (214)
Sarah K: I added 2 tbsp honey and a handful of walnuts, delicious!
Mike: Can I use gluten free flour?

Recipe text:
Slow-roast pork shoulder
Prep: 20 min | Cook: 4 hr 30 mins | Serves 6-8

2 kg pork shoulder, skin scored
1 tbsp fennel seeds
2 tsp sea salt
4 garlic cloves
500 ml cider

1. Heat the oven to 220C. Rub the skin with the fennel and salt.
2. Roast for 30 minutes, then turn the oven down to 160C.
3. Add the garlic and cider to the tin and roast for 4 hours more.
4. Rest for 20 minutes before carving.

Recipe text:
Weeknight Chili
This Tex-Mex classic is our go-to weeknight dinner.
Serves: 6 | Prep: 15 minutes | Cook: 45 minutes

1 lb ground beef
1 yellow onion, diced
2 tbsp chili powder
1 (14 oz) can diced tomatoes
1 (15 oz) can kidney beans, drained
1 cup beef broth

1. Brown the beef and onion in a large pot, about 8 minutes.
2. Stir in the chili powder and cook 1 minute.
3. Add the tomatoes, beans and broth. Simmer, covered, for 30-35 minutes.

Recipe text:
Garlic butter prawns (Spanish-style), a quick lunch for 2

250 g raw king prawns
30 g butter
3 garlic cloves, sliced
Chilli flakes (optional)
1 tbsp chopped parsley, if you like
Crusty bread, to serve

Melt the butter in a frying pan. Add the garlic and chilli and cook for 1 minute. Add the prawns and cook for 3 minutes until pink. Scatter with parsley.

Recipe text:
Thai green chicken curry
A classic Thai dinner. Serves 4. Prep 20 minutes, cook 25 minutes.

For the paste
2 green chillies
1 lemongrass stalk
4 cm piece of ginger
3 garlic cloves
1 small bunch of coriander
1 tsp ground cumin
1 tsp ground coriander
1 lime, zested and juiced
2 tbsp fish sauce

For the curry
1 tbsp vegetable oil
600 g chicken thighs, sliced
400 ml tin coconut milk
200 ml chicken stock
150 g green beans, trimmed
1 tsp brown sugar
Thai basil leaves, to serve

Method
1. Blitz all the paste ingredients in a food processor until smooth.
2. Heat the oil in a wok over a high heat.
3. Fry the paste for 2 minutes until fragrant.
4. Add the chicken and stir-fry for 5 minutes.
5. Pour in the coconut milk and stock.
6. Bring to a simmer and cook for 10 minutes.
7. Add the green beans and cook for 4 minutes more.
8. Stir in the sugar and check the seasoning.
9. Taste and add more fish sauce or lime if needed.
10. Scatter with Thai basil and serve with rice.

Recipe text:
Roast potatoes. Serves 4. Prep 10 mins, cook 1 hr.

1.2 kg floury potatoes, peeled and halved
4 tbsp sunflower oil

1. Boil the potatoes for 10 mins, then drain and shake to rough up the edges.
2. Heat the oil in a roasting tin in a 220C oven for 5 minutes.
3. Add the potatoes and roast for 45-50 minutes, turning halfway.
